title: RF exposure
blurb: The big idea before the cards.

lines.caption: Radio waves are non-ionizing. They cannot damage the DNA in your cells. But strong radio energy heats body tissue.
lines.label: non-ionizing, but it heats

lines.caption: How much reaches you depends on the power, the frequency, how far you are from the antenna, and which way it beams.
lines.label: closer means more

lines.caption: Your body soaks up some frequencies more than others. Of the bands on the exam, 50 megahertz has the lowest limit.
lines.label: 50 megahertz: lowest limit

lines.caption: Exposure is averaged over time. Transmit less of the time and the average goes down.
lines.label: duty cycle

lines.caption: Never touch an antenna while it transmits. And as the licensee, keeping everyone safe is your job.
lines.label: your station, your job
